product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™HDMI® HDBaseT Extender [TAA]Extend HDMI® 4K60 video up to 100 meters over Cat6a cable.The Blackbird™ HDMI® HDBaseT Extender by Monoprice™ sends signals up to 100 meters (328 feet) over a single Cat6a cable, or up to 70 meters over standard Cat6 cable. Alternately, the HDMI HDBaseT Extender can also serve as an extremely long-range extender for 1080p signals up to 150 meters over Cat5e, making it perfect for digital signage such as menu boards or hospitality displays.This unit extends HDMI signals in either the DCI standard (4096 × 2160) or UHD standard (3840 × 2160), both at 60 Hz (4:2:0) resolution, or 30 Hz (4:4:4) resolution while supporting HDCP 2.2, 3D, Deep Color, HD lossless audio formats, and CEC pass-through.Extend 4K@60Hz HDMI® video up to 100 meters over a Cat6a cableSupports 4096 × 2160 @ 60 Hz (4:2:0) and 4096 × 2160 @ 30 Hz (4:4:4) resolutionsSupports HDCP 2.2, plus 3D and Deep ColorSupports HDBaseT Long Reach Mode, sending 1080p signals up to 150 meters over Cat5e cableSupports CEC (Consumer Electronic Control) for interconnected HDMI devices SUPPORTS DCI 4K AND UHD 4K STANDARDSFull 4096 × 2160 @ 60 Hz (4:4:4) resolution allows use with PCs and projectors that support the DCI 4K standard, plus all 4K UHD-supported devices. SUPPORTS 1080P TO 150 METERSAllows viewing of uncompressed 4K HDMI video in real time, from up to 100 meters (328 feet) away. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x HDMI HDBaseT Transmitter• 1x HDMI HDBaseT Receiver• 1x Power Adapter• 1x User Manual Pick The Perfect HDMI Extender That Fits Your Needs.comp-img {max-height: 300px}.comp-copy-col {background-color:#F1F1F1}  P/N4456744559Max.
